inputs.text: Vertical cinematic two-person composition presented as a clean video-call split frame. On the left, the same adult Chinese woman age 28 in her apartment, same oval face, low ponytail, light blue shirt, charcoal blazer and silver necklace, frightened but attentive, slowly lowering her phone. On the right, an adult Chinese male police officer age 35 with square face and short neat black hair wears a dark navy duty uniform without readable badge numbers and raises one open palm in a firm stop gesture. Both are premium handcrafted 3D plush dolls with soft flocked fabric and subtle seams, rounded chibi adult proportions. The woman's side shifts from cold to warmer light; the officer side is neutral professional light. No text, no badge numbers, no watermark, correct hands.
